notes: Source is HTML pages (page=null). Values are "alin pisteraja lopullisessa valinnassa" (final selection incl. reserve-place filling), with the date given in the source (e.g. 7.8.2026, 18.8.2026, 3.7.2025, 4.7.2024, 27.5.2024); dates vary per programme, so some values reflect later reserve-list stages than others. Ensikertalainen/ei-ensikertalainen split is published only for the autumn-2026 intake (and Liiketalous monimuoto Helsinki autumn 2025); everything else is one number and recorded as single. "-" for ei-ensikertalaiset recorded as null. Liiketalous päivä Helsinki 2026 gives 103/103 (same value for both). Spring-2027 rows ("xx") are unpublished and omitted. Rows that only have valintakurssi or entrance-exam cutoffs (Restonomi monimuoto Helsinki K2025/K2026, Ruokatuotanto monimuoto K2024-K2026, International Business blended, Sports Coaching and Management) have no YO certificate queue and are omitted. Vipunen hakukohteet without any YO cutoff on the source: Restonomi matkailu- ja tapahtuma-ala päivätoteutus Porvoo (2024, 2025). English-taught programmes: for autumn 2026 and spring 2026 the source separates a matriculation-type certificate queue (YO/IB/EB/RP/DIA, /198) from a vocational one (/150); only the former is recorded. For 2024-2025 intakes the source lists only one "Certificate-based selection" queue (alongside the International UAS exam); these rows are included with a per-row note because the page does not explicitly call it the YO queue (see queueLabel/note) - drop them if strict YO labelling is required. Some January-2025/2026 English values have no printed maximum. The 2026-autumn values are much lower than earlier years for several programmes (e.g. BIT 45, Aviation 60), reflecting the source's late (August) final-selection dates; copied as published.
